spearheads.name: Fangs of the Blood God
spearheads.text:
Woe unto those who draw the Blood God's deepest ire. From the depths of the Brass Citadel, a monstrous daemonic hunter is unleashed to drag their souls back to his master's throne: Karanak, the Hound of Vengeance. Each of his three heads are ever salivating for the taste of fresh prey, and his pursuit takes him through the realms of mortals without breaking stride. The conventions of military strategy find no purchase upon his animalistic mind; nothing does, save the need to run his quarry to the ground.
While Karanak does not care to lead in a recognisable sense, there are always those who follow in his wake. Packs of Flesh Hounds driven mad by the coming of their alpha spill from the Realm of Chaos, whilst amongst the desolate wilderlands, warbands of mortal cultists howl as the red moons rise and seek to earn their place in the divine pursuit. These Fangs of the Blood God, as myth knows such hellish hunters, make for a murderous nemesis. It matters not to Karanak how many of his followers fall so long as his jaws can clamp around his target in a bloody spray.

battle_traits.name: THE QUARRY
battle_traits.effect: If no enemy units are the quarry, pick an enemy unit to be the quarry (you can pick an enemy unit in reserve).

battle_traits.name: BLOOD-DRENCHED
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly unit that slew any enemy models using a FIGHT ability this turn to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: For the rest of the battle, the target’s melee weapons have Crit (Mortal).

regiment_abilities.name: THE SCENT OF BLOOD
regiment_abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls and add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks that target an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn.

regiment_abilities.name: SAVAGERY UPON SAVAGERY
regiment_abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit in combat to be the target.
regiment_abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons. If the target is a HERO, add D3 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons instead.

enhancements.name: KILLING POUNCE
enhancements.effect: For the rest of the turn, when making charge rolls for your general, you can roll an additional dice, to a maximum of 3, but if you do, they must finish that charge in combat with the quarry.

enhancements.name: EVASIVE HUNTER
enhancements.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for shooting attacks that target your general.

enhancements.name: FURIOUS BITES
enhancements.effect: If your general is in combat with the quarry, inflict D3 mortal damage on the quarry.

abilities.name: STALK THE PREY
abilities.effect: This unit can move D6". It cannot end that move in combat unless it was in combat at the start of that move and, if there is an enemy quarry on the battlefield, it must end that move closer to the quarry.

abilities.name: UNFLAGGING HUNTERS
abilities.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for this unit.

abilities.name: PACK HUNTERS
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with both this unit and a friendly Flesh Hounds unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit’s combat attacks that target that enemy unit score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

spearheads.name: Bloodbound Gore Pilgrims
spearheads.text:
The Bloodbound are Khorne’s sacred destroyers. These mortals have not only earned the War God’s mark but also his favour, and they channel it through acts of harrowing close-quarters brutality. Khorne’s warriors claim that his only true temple is the battlefield, his only prayers the screams of the dying, and his only libations the blood of the slain. Some, however, become especially ritualistic in their killing, believing that each life extinguished allows their god to project more of his essence into reality. These warbands are known as Gore Pilgrims and form honour guards for the raving warrior priests of the Blood God.
Following the bellowed commands of their Slaughterpriest master, throngs of Bloodreavers charge forwards, heedless of their own lives – for Khorne demands only slaughter as a price for his boons. Blood Warriors drive the foe from their places of security, reconsecrating lands to their raging patron with each enemy they cut down. Amongst many Bloodbound hordes, packs of Mighty Skullcrushers are outsiders, realm-roaming warriors who join a tribe only for immediate carnage. Those who fight with the Gore Pilgrims, however, are the most rabid of true believers – a brass stampede that is first into the fray and the last ones standing when Khorne’s holy work is done.

battle_traits.name: THE BLOOD TITHE
battle_traits.effect: Each time a unit is destroyed during the battle, you receive 1 blood tithe point.

battle_traits.name: HEADS MUST ROLL
battle_traits.declare: Spend 3 blood tithe points and pick up to 3 friendly units.
battle_traits.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of those units’ melee weapons until the start of your next turn.

battle_traits.name: MURDERLUST
battle_traits.declare: Spend 1 blood tithe point and pick up to D3 friendly units.
battle_traits.effect: Each of those units can move D6" (roll for each).

regiment_abilities.name: FAVOURED OF KHORNE
regiment_abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, you receive 1 blood tithe point.

regiment_abilities.name: BLOOD-WOKEN RUNES
regiment_abilities.effect: Friendly units have WARD (5+) if they have used a FIGHT ability in the same phase.

enhancements.name: RESANGUINATION
enhancements.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 16" of your general, then make a chanting roll of D6.

enhancements.name: HEADHUNTER
enhancements.declare: Pick an enemy HERO in combat with your general.
enhancements.effect: Your general has STRIKE-FIRST this phase, but all attacks made by them this phase must target that enemy HERO.

enhancements.name: UNHOLY FLAMES
enhancements.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 16" of your general, then make a chanting roll of D6.
enhancements.effect: On a 4+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that unit’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: BLOOD BOIL
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 16" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: On a 4+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: BLOOD SACRIFICE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target and you gain 1 blood tithe point.

abilities.name: NO RESPITE
abilities.effect: Each time a model in this unit is slain, you can pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and roll a dice. On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

abilities.name: FRENZIED DEVOTION
abilities.effect: If this unit is within 8" of your general, you can return D3 slain models to this unit.

abilities.name: BRASS STAMPEDE
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target, then roll a dice.
abilities.effect: On a 2+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
